prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Changes:
0: [sign_in, redesign] Multi-Account Sync Verification Split View: Redesigns the sign-in screen into a split view showing active account status on one side and sign-in options on the other. (why: Support received 8 emails reporting pets missing or reset after signing in again with different accounts.)
1: [finish, redesign] Interactive Desktop Pet Control Playbook Redesign: Redesigns home_intro into an interactive spotlight layout showing exact desktop shortcuts to call, hide, or talk to the pet. (why: 3 support tickets reported post-onboarding confusion on how to control or interact with their pet on desktop.)
2: [adoption, hint] Custom Pet Generation Resolution Guidance Hint: Adds photo framing and lighting requirement callouts to the photo upload screen. (why: 3 support emails reported custom pet generation failures or unexpected visual output.)
3: [sign_in, hint] Account Session Safety Status Banner: Adds an explicit account preservation notice to the sign-in screen. (why: 8 support emails cited lost pet profiles caused by signing into new empty accounts.)
4: [finish, incentive] First Companion Desktop Command Mastery Badge: Displays a desktop control mastery badge on the completion screen encouraging users to trigger their first pet action. (why: Finish step drop-off is 23.9% (76.1% conversion) with long mean idle time (5815s); interactive goals increase final completion.)
5: [choose_path, layout] Stage Path Comparison Matrix View: Replaces standard path option cards with a structured stage comparison layout showing feature differences between choices. (why: Conversion at choose_path is 83.0%, indicating users need clearer contrast between available path options.)
6: [home, notification] Desktop Spawn Audio-Visual Overlay Alert: Enables a visual ready notification toggle on the waiting screen so users know when rendering completes while working in other apps. (why: Waiting stage mean duration is 2336s compared to median 201s, proving users switch tasks while waiting and lose track of app readiness.)
